blockers.target: Tall continuous grass and willow masses rise above the waterline and obscure most of the outer bank shoulders.
blockers.current: Short tufts trace the two shores while broad bare slopes and several fully exposed boulders occupy the space above them.
blockers.change: Build overlapping clumps of tall grass and branching shrubs up both shoulders, using the roughly one-sixth-frame-height stands at the outside edges as the silhouette guide.

blockers.target: A two-step white cascade connects the notch between the rocks to the lake, with a small bright reflection beneath it.
blockers.current: The opening contains a brown ramp and a flat pale triangle at lake level, leaving the vertical cascade absent.
blockers.change: Carry a narrow blue-white ribbon over both rock lips and down to the lake across roughly 2% of the frame width and 4% of its height.

blockers.target: Low varied projections and grass-covered shallows break up both shoulders of the lake.
blockers.current: The former black slit has closed, but long smooth arcs of bare brown earth still outline the lake on either side.
blockers.change: Break each arc with several low, irregular planted projections and feather the submerged edges into gravel and shallow water.

next.target: Olive reflections give way to blue-grey shallows with bright wakes curling around the inclined rock faces.
next.current: Broad blue and gold reflection patches meet a brown streambed, and the blocky rocks have only faint grey streaks at their bases.
next.change: Mute the gold reflection, cool the shallow surface, bevel the steep rock faces and wrap thin broken white wakes around the upstream edges and downstream flanks of all three rocks.

next.target: Grass roots hang across a softly lit earth face that slopes into a narrow toe of grey cobbles.
next.current: The turf overhangs a sharply defined near-black gap that obscures the face and its base.
next.change: Fill the dark gap with a sloping soil face, raise scattered cobbles against its lower edge and drape irregular roots over its top lip.

next.target: Mixed round grey pebbles and cobbles pile above the water and overlap the grass roots.
next.current: The shelf reads as a narrow, nearly flat band of pale ochre gravel with little variation in stone height.
next.change: Build a convex ridge of overlapping grey stones from pebble to fist size, densest near the waterline and thinning unevenly into the grass.
